basic_info.description: Fabulous 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom residence in the newly completed 350 San Jose, a collection of 13 contemporary residences in an enviable Noe Valley location.  This second-floor condominium boasts a fantastic floor plan with a large island kitchen including a fully integrated, cabinet-faced refrigerator, dishwasher, quartz countertops and under cabinet lighting. One luxurious bathroom is fit for a spa with designer tile finishes, quartz vanity top with dual under-mounted sinks, widespread faucets and walk-in shower with glass partition and hand-shower.  Other features include underfloor heating and private garden space!
